verdict.rationale: Lago ships AI agents (Dunning Agent, generic AI agent SDK, MCP server) that read billing/account data and can act or suggest actions in natural language, which is adjacent to 'AI-generated insights from data,' but there is no dedicated in-product analytics/insights UI (e.g., AI commentary on revenue dashboards) — the revenue-analytics page describes only manual custom dashboards with no AI layer. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-generated insight/summary UI on analytics dashboards, independent/hands-on evidence of the AI agents producing data-driven insights rather than task automation.
